input.quote: f) IBM agrees that, for a period of [*] years from the Effective Date of this Agreement, it will not in any way solicit for employment any Transferred Employees without the prior written consent of MSL
input.rationale: Section 9.0(f) is a one-way non-solicit binding only IBM (our party); MSL takes no reciprocal obligation, so the fallback's mutuality element fails. It also fails fallback on scope and duration: it covers every Transferred Employee irrespective of whether that person is directly involved in the work, and it runs for a period of years measured from the Effective Date rather than 12 months from the end of the individual's involvement. The general-advertising and unsolicited-contact carve-outs are present, and the covenant is a solicitation restriction rather than a no-hire, but those points do not cure the material failures. We therefore move to the preferred position and replace the covenant with a short confirmation that IBM is not restricted from soliciting or employing Transferred Employees; a conforming mutual, 12-month, involvement-limited covenant is offered as fallback in the comment.

proposal.summary: Remove the one-way non-solicitation covenant binding IBM in Section 9.0(f).
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have replaced the Section 9.0(f) covenant with an express confirmation that IBM is not restricted from soliciting or employing Transferred Employees, consistent with our position that no non-solicitation restriction binds us. If you need a covenant here, we can accept a mutual one limited to personnel directly involved in the Services for 12 months after their involvement ends, with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and no restriction on hiring.

ops.oldText: f) IBM agrees that, for a period of [*] years from the Effective Date of this Agreement, it will not in any way solicit for employment any Transferred Employees without the prior written consent of MSL; provided, however, that the foregoing will not restrict or prevent IBM from a) employing any such person who contacts IBM on his or her own initiative without any solicitation or encouragement from IBM or b) by using general employment advertising or communications or independent search firms, hiring any person who responds thereto, provided that IBM does not direct or encourage such independent search firms to solicit such Transferred Employees.
ops.newText: f) Nothing in this Agreement restricts IBM from soliciting for employment or employing any Transferred Employees.
